name: viewforge-3d-toolkit
description: Quality-gated local geometry generation, multi-view 3D construction, controlled Blender modeling, biological skeleton animation, no-skin rigid binding, mesh refinement, and same-geometry appearance skills.

interface.shortDescription: Build, animate, rig, and refine traceable 3D models.
interface.longDescription: Use the bundled local geometry runtime for procedural and multi-view modeling, or controlled declarative Blender jobs for general objects; create and animate bone-only biological armatures, rigid-bind segmented models without skin weights, refine bounded regions, validate topology and provenance, and apply appearance without moving accepted geometry.
defaultPrompt: Use $viewforge-3d-toolkit:viewforge-3d-router to choose the safe workflow for this 3D task.

Call viewforge_status before local geometry work. Prefer the bundled non-Blender modeling tools when they match; use build_declarative_blender_model for controlled general modeling and never request arbitrary local scripts.
Use $viewforge-3d-toolkit:build-biological-skeleton to build a bone-only Armature for a person or animal without weights.
Use $viewforge-3d-toolkit:animate-biological-skeleton to animate bones and rigid-bind segmented body parts without skin weights.
